capabilities: configure a POST endpoint with an API key and secret
mark notes for publishing via template frontmatter
publish a note through a right-click command
extras: Setup relies on a Templates-based workflow; the README gives no error handling or troubleshooting guidance.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send a note's content to an arbitrary external API endpoint via HTTP POST.

requires.name: API key and secret for the endpoint

summary: Publishes a single note to a configured POST API endpoint, authenticating with an API key and secret.
